name: cityjson-wasm-smoke
description: Node runtime smoke test for the DuckDB-Wasm build of the cityjson extension.

comments.@duckdb/duckdb-wasm: Pinned exactly. 1.33.1-dev57.0 is the `latest` dist-tag and embeds DuckDB v1.5.4 (source_id 08e34c447b) -- byte-identical to what `just build` produces here, so the wasm_mvp extension's footer matches. A different duckdb-wasm release means a different DuckDB, and the extension is rejected on its version footer; re-pin only together with the extension's DuckDB version.
